ⓑ There _________ some good news for you.
ⓒ There _________ some snow on the bench.
ⓓ There _________ a lot of mistakes in this page.
ⓔ There _________ a number of people in the park.
solution: ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에는 is가 들어가고, ⓓ, ⓔ에는 are가 들어간다. ‘~이 있다’라는 뜻의 ‘There+is/are+명사(구)’의 구문에서 뒤의 명사(구)가 주어이므로, be동사는 뒤의 명사(구)에 수일치하여 ‘There are+복수명사(구)’로, ‘There is+단수명사(구) 또는 불가 산명사(구)’로 쓴다. ⓐ 주어 no room은 단수명사구이므로 빈칸에는 is가 들어간다. ⓑ 주어는 some good news로, 주어의 핵심 단어인 news는 불가산명사이므로 단수명사 is가 들어간다. ⓒ 주어 some snow의 핵심 단어인 snow는 불가산명사이므로 단수명사 is가 들어간다.

body:
My teacher told us about tomorrow’s presentation.
He asked us, “What do you want to be when you
ⓐgrow up?” I said to myself, “Oh, no. Not again!
What do I want to be? I have no idea.”
At home, I asked my family about their dream jobs.
Dad said, “Well, I wanted to be an astronaut when I
was young. I wanted to travel to the moon.”
“When I grow up, I’m going to be a robot
designer,” said my big sister Angela.
My little sister Sophie shouted, “I’m going to be a
ⓑsuperhero or a bird!”
Dad asked me, “What about you, Noah? What do
you want to be?”
I was stressed out.
Later, Mom came home from work.
“Noah, is everything okay?” she asked.
“No, Mom. (A)[Something / Nothing] is wrong with
me. I’m not going to be anything in the future.”
“What do you ⓒmean?” she asked.
“Everyone has a dream job. Even Sophie does. And
she’s only three!” I cried.
“Oh, Noah. I don’t know my dream job.”
“What? But you’re a grown-up, and you have a job,” I said.
“That’s right, but …”
“And you take care of everyone. You have the answers
to everything,” I went on. “You’re always nice, and you’re
not ⓓafraid of anything. Most of all, you’re my mom!”
Mom smiled and said, “I hope you are (B)[wrong /
right]. I wanted to become that kind of person.”
“Mom! You’re already that ⓔkind of person!”
Just then, I had an idea. “That’s it! Thanks, Mom!”
The next day, I gave a presentation.
“What do I want to be when I grow up? I don’t
know. Who do I want to be? I know that!
I want to be a caring person. I want to (C)[ignore
/ look after] others. I also want to be a brave
person. I want to try new things.
Who do I want to be? I want to be me.”

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ의 영영풀이로 어색한 것을모두 골라 짝지은 것은?

<보기>
ⓐ to develop into an adult
ⓑ a character in a cartoon or film who has special
powers and fights against evil
ⓒ not willing to give or share things, especially money
ⓓ frightened because you think that you think
that something bad may happen
ⓔ caring about others; gentle, friendly and generous
solution: ⓒ의 mean은 ‘의미하다’라는 동사이므로, 형용사로 쓰인 mean (인색한)의 다른 뜻인 ‘not willing to give or share things, especially money(물건, 특히 돈을 기꺼이 주거나 나누지 않 는)’은 영영풀이로 알맞지 않다. ‘to express or represent something such as an idea, thought, or fact(아이디어, 생각, 사실과 같은 것을 표현하거나 나타내다)로 고쳐야 한다. ⓔ의 kind는 ’종류‘라는 뜻의 명사이므로 형용사 kind(친절한) 의 또 다른 뜻인 ’caring about others; gentle, friendly and generous(다른 사람을 신경 쓰고, 상냥하고, 친절하며 너그러 운)‘은 알맞지 않다. ’a group of people or things that are the same in some way(어떤 면에서 같은 사람이나 사람들의 그룹)‘으로 고쳐야 한다.
